name: Jaduguda Underground Science Laboratory
notes: No official JUSL page was found; the laboratory is known here only from the InDEx papers. Overburden in m.w.e. and the operating body are unresolved.

summary.plain: A small underground laboratory, 555 metres down at Jaduguda in Jharkhand, India, where the InDEx experiment looks for dark matter with droplet detectors.
summary.technical: JUSL: underground laboratory at 555 m depth at Jaduguda (East Singhbhum, Jharkhand); hosts the InDEx superheated-emulsion dark matter search. Operator, founding date and rock overburden in m.w.e. are not given in the sources read.
